features: 20-Hour Battery Life: This portable speaker features a massive 2400mAh battery, delivering up to 20 hours of non-stop music playback on a single charge, allowing you to enjoy the party from dawn to dusk. It's perfect for extended outdoor adventures or relaxing at the beach.

Ultimate Outdoor Protection & Floatable Design: With an IP68 waterproof and dustproof rating and 1.22-meter drop resistance — rigorously tested and certified by SGS — this wireless speaker is built to withstand any adventure. It even floats on water, making it perfect for pool parties, beach trips, showers, and all kinds of water activities.
Immersive, Powerful Sound: This compact speaker features 45mm neodymium drivers and 7W of output power, delivering powerful, rich, detailed sound that surpasses its size, ensuring clear audio.

Ultralight 220g Design & Outdoor Ready: Weighing only 220g (0.49 lbs), this ultra-portable Bluetooth speaker is your perfect outdoor companion. Its feather-light design easily clips to backpacks or fits in cup holders, making it ideal for hiking, cycling, beach trips and camping adventures. The compact portable speaker delivers big sound without the bulk.
TWS Pairing for Stereo Sound: Easily pair two speakers together via True Wireless Stereo (TWS) technology to create a powerful left-right stereo system for an immersive soundstage.
